title: Markov Constraints Enhance Identifiability in Quantum Shadow Inversion
summary: We study quantum shadow inversion under Markovian locality constraints for four-partite systems arranged along the chain $A$--$B$--$C$--$D$. The goal is to reproduce the expectation value of a fixed endpoint observable $O_{AD}$ after an unknown global unitary, without requiring full unitary inversion. We formulate the task using Markov-admissible supermaps and introduce the Markov-implementable centralizer to describe the remaining endpoint gauge freedom.
